    7: (2, 5),
    8: (3, 4),
    9: (3, 5),
    10: (4, 5)
}

# Track participation days for each player (1-indexed)
player_days = {i: set() for i in range(1, 6)}

for day, (p1, p2) in schedule.items():
    player_days[p1].add(day)
    player_days[p2].add(day)

total_cost = 0
player_spans = {}

for player, days in player_days.items():
    if not days:
        span = 0
    else:
        start_day = min(days)
        end_day = max(days)
        # Cost is (End Day - Start Day + 1)
        span = end_day - start_day + 1
    
    player_spans[player] = span
    total_cost += span

print(f"Player Spans: {player_spans}")
print(f"Total Cost: {total_cost}")
